_comment: Items are deliberately few. Milestone 1 tracks inventories but applies no item effects.

items.name: Headlamp (Dept. Issue)
items.description: Batteries at 40%. Lets a team act in a hex that would otherwise stop them.

items.name: Torn Topo Fragment
items.description: One quadrant of the map, with contour lines that do not match the ground.

items.name: Form 7-B Day Use Permit
items.description: Countersigned. Allegedly improves the outcome of an escape test.

items.name: Shed Antler Charm
items.description: Carried for luck. Re-rolls one failed test.
